about.title: About
about.metaDescription: Oracle Services Sarl is a consultancy and connector company registered in Kolwezi, DRC, operating countrywide with a pan-African outlook.
about.heading: Connecting needs with solutions
about.intro: Oracle Services Sarl is a consultancy and service supply company registered in Kolwezi, Democratic Republic of the Congo.
whoText: We partner with suppliers of products and services across different sectors: fintech, financial institutions, solution builders, mining and industry, and others.
Our role is simple: understand what our customers need and connect them with the partner who can deliver it.
baseText: Kolwezi, in Lualaba province, is known as the Copper Capital of the World. This is where we are registered.
We operate across the DRC. Our outlook is pan-African, with a global view — without borders.
about.visionText: Work with our partners to exceed our customers' expectations.
about.modelText: The customer brings us their need. We select the right partner. We deliver together, with one point of contact for the customer.
about.closing: Join us on this journey of success in our beloved continent, Africa. Our continent deserves world-class services and project execution.
